trait_policy.denominator: Unique deck Characters; exclude Leaders, Actions, Items, copies, and temporarily gained Traits.
trait_policy.notes: Traits are exact labels, never automatic abilities. Zero is valid. Actions, Items, and Leaders may carry useful Traits, but this pool prints them only on Characters. Human remains unprinted audit metadata. Limits are design guidance, not deckbuilding restrictions.

traits.name: Animal
traits.meaning: An animal Character, including an explicitly animal Undead Character.

traits.name: Undead
traits.meaning: A Character whose fiction explicitly includes returning from death. Survival alone does not qualify.

traits.name: Construct
traits.meaning: An animated, built, or manufactured Character. Ordinary Items are not Constructs.

traits.name: Rat
traits.meaning: A rat, printed alongside Animal when both apply. Other scavenging animals are not Rats.

traits.name: Kid
traits.meaning: A child or teen in the depicted Character concept.

traits.name: Parent
traits.meaning: A parent or grandparent, without implying a separate Human rule.

traits.name: Criminal
traits.meaning: A Character depicted committing theft, fraud, or another crime. A job, wealth, or an annoying personality is insufficient.

traits.name: Musician
traits.meaning: A musical performer. Road crew and general entertainers are not automatically Musicians.

traits.name: Pirate
traits.meaning: A deliberately pirate-themed Character. A pun in a title does not grant this Trait.

traits.name: Scout
traits.meaning: A member of the fictional Scout troop, including its quartermaster.

traits.name: HOA
traits.meaning: A member of the fictional homeowners association or its administration. General authority figures do not qualify automatically.

traits.name: Daredevil
traits.meaning: A Character who deliberately performs dangerous stunts.

traits.name: Wrestler
traits.meaning: A participating backyard wrestler. Fans, referees, and support staff do not qualify merely by proximity.

traits.name: Scavenger
traits.meaning: A Character who obtains supplies or food from discarded material.

traits.name: Builder
traits.meaning: A Character who builds or repairs things, however questionable the workmanship.

traits.name: Hacker
traits.meaning: A Character whose depicted activity involves exploiting or manipulating computer systems.

traits.name: Clown
traits.meaning: An actual clown performer. Being foolish is insufficient.

traits.name: Magician
traits.meaning: A stage-magic or escape performer; no supernatural rules are implied.

keywords.name: Hothead
keywords.definition: This Character may Attack on the Turn it enters play.
keywords.limits: Does not Ready it, grant an extra Attack, allow its own Rotate abilities early, or override a cannot-Attack effect.

keywords.name: Defiant
keywords.definition: This Character retaliates when it Blocks even if the incoming Attack Defeats it.
keywords.limits: Applies to blocking retaliation. Slowpoke prevents this retaliation if both apply.

keywords.name: Explosive
keywords.definition: When this Character is Defeated, deal 1 damage to each opposing Character.
keywords.limits: This is a Defeat trigger and does not damage Leaders, Items, or friendly Characters.

keywords.name: Slowpoke
keywords.definition: This Character does not retaliate when it Blocks.
keywords.limits: It may still Attack and may retaliate after surviving a direct Attack.

keywords.name: Sucker Punch
keywords.definition: This Character may Attack Ready opposing Characters.
keywords.limits: The direct Attack cannot be Blocked and follows normal damage and retaliation. Entry-Turn restrictions still apply unless another effect grants Hothead.

keywords.name: Jerry-Rig
keywords.definition: If this Item would go to your discard, you may put it face up and Rotated into your Stash instead. When this card is used to pay a Cost, discard it.
keywords.limits: While in Stash, this card is not mechanically an Item. Its face-up state only marks it as temporary Stash.

keywords.name: Chicken
keywords.definition: When this Character is attacked, you may Return it to your hand.
keywords.limits: Optional. Returning it ends the Attack before combat damage if it was the direct target.

keywords.name: Stubborn
keywords.definition: The first time each Round this Character would be Returned or Dismissed, it remains in play instead.
keywords.limits: Protects against both Return and Dismiss once per Round.

keywords.name: Bodyguard
keywords.definition: This Character may be attacked while Ready. While Ready, it must Block an Attack against your Leader if able.
keywords.limits: This changes legal direct-attack targeting and mandatory blocking while Ready.

notes: Traits have no automatic behavior and may exist in the pool before they receive dedicated support.
Trait-support cards should usually remain useful without the matching Trait; the Trait payoff is upside, not the card's only function.
Rat does not imply Animal, and gaining Undead does not grant Zombie or remove existing Traits. Print every label an effect should see.
Sneaky, Cloak, Stack, Step Aside, and Overkill are shelved for the starting rebuild.
Jerry-Rig is being tested on every current Salvage Item.
